title:
Receives a {@link Period} serialized as `string` and builds a {@link DateTime} from it.
Then, it serializes the {@link DateTime} as `string` to be used in the UI.

The format is `({date}, 12:00 AM) - Present`, where `date` is `now() - period`.

@see ReliabilityTransformUtil#dateMinusPeriod
name: PeriodToDateTimeStringTransform
